independent_ast_closure.guard_scope: Receipt lookup/publication/rollback, numeric and HoldPose admission, Rest/control mapping, four clock guards, context override, track creation, enter/rollback and exit logic are AST-equal outside _tweak.

source_review.defect: Python identity of iterated NlaTrack wrappers is not native RNA identity. Existing is predicates could deselect the owned track and strip even while assigning that native track active.
source_review.selection_gate: Exactly one native-equal current track, exactly one Action-bearing strip; all track/strip select values and the native-equal active collection pointer are read back before the operator.
source_review.operator_gate: Existing EXEC_DEFAULT official entry retains isolate_action=False and use_upper_stack_evaluation=True. Success additionally requires use_tweak_mode and exact resulting Action and action_slot_handle.
source_review.readonly_active: No strip.active or track.active boolean assignment is introduced.
source_review.full_stack: Upper-stack evaluation remains enabled; the tweaked track is replaced by the active Action while tracks above stay evaluated. No Solo fallback is added.
source_review.context: Operator poll requires NLA editor and a Scene not already in Tweak. It has no Object-only mode gate. Existing selected rig/filter/window override is unchanged; actual background context remains a native acceptance requirement.

official_primary_sources.proof: The active native track is chosen first. When it has no active strip, its selected strip is accepted; one Action strip satisfies finder admission.
NlaTracks.active getter and setter use BKE_nlatrack_find_active/set_active; collection active pointer is writable.
NlaStrip.active is readonly, select writable. NlaTrack registration does not provide Python instance caching.
RNA equality compares native data and type. Collection iteration wraps native pointers; wrapper reuse is conditional on supported instance caching.
RNA_struct_instance returns no cache when this type/base has no instance callback.
Tweak entry poll requires NLA editor and Scene Tweak flag off, with no Object/Pose restriction.
Visible AnimData is filtered, upper-stack and isolation properties applied, then BKE entry called. The observed No active strip error follows a nonempty AnimData list with no successful kernel entry.
The current track is disabled against duplicate evaluation; upper tracks remain when upper-stack flag is set. Kernel assigns strip Action and slot and records tweak state.

limitations: Source uses the official blender-v5.2-release branch, not an installed binary commit pin.
Fresh-wrapper pure tests exercise actual extracted Python logic; they do not execute Blender native operator/context. Owner test results are reported, not independently rerun.
n10 remains a real failed native attempt. No rerun or successful numeric/physical/seed result is inferred from this repair.
A separately authorized tiny native context/Action-slot/Full-Stack enter/exit microtest can cheaply close installed API uncertainty; a future complete native fixture is still needed.
No historical report, frozen projection, candidate, packet, model or artist file was modified.
